reactable(
  all_distances,

  defaultPageSize = 100, style = list(fontSize = "13px"),
  columns = list(
    alignment_file = colDef(name = "Alignment File", show = show_file_col, minWidth = 120),

    K80 = colDef(name = "Kimura 2-P (K80)", format = colFormat(digits = 4), cell = function(value) if(is.nan(value) || is.na(value)) "-" else value),
    JC69 = colDef(name = "Jukes-Cantor (JC69)", format = colFormat(digits = 4), cell = function(value) if(is.nan(value) || is.na(value)) "-" else value),
    TN93 = colDef(name = "Tamura-Nei (TN93)", format = colFormat(digits = 4), cell = function(value) if(is.nan(value) || is.na(value)) "-" else value),
    T92 = colDef(name = "Tamura 3-P (T92)", format = colFormat(digits = 4), cell = function(value) if(is.nan(value) || is.na(value)) "-" else value)
  )
)

## MOTU Genetic Distance Matrix

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

# Generate sunset palette function
pal_sunset <- carto_pal(7, "Sunset")
color_ramp <- colorRamp(pal_sunset)

# Helper function to generate RGBA colors dynamically (opacity 0.2)
get_rgba <- function(val, max_val) {
  if (is.na(val) || !is.numeric(val)) return("transparent")
  norm_val <- max(0, min(1, val / max_val))
  rgb <- color_ramp(norm_val)
  sprintf("rgba(%f, %f, %f, 0.2)", rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3])
}

# Output script for dropdown toggle
cat('
<select id="metricDropdown" class="metric-selector" onchange="toggleMetricMatrix()">
  <option value="raw">Uncorrected (p-distance)</option>
  <option value="K80">Kimura 2-P (K80)</option>
  <option value="JC69">Jukes-Cantor (JC69)</option>
  <option value="TN93">Tamura-Nei (TN93)</option>
  <option value="T92">Tamura 3-P (T92)</option>
</select>

<script>
function toggleMetricMatrix() {
  var selected = document.getElementById("metricDropdown").value;
  var matrices = document.getElementsByClassName("dist-matrix");
  for (var i = 0; i < matrices.length; i++) {
    matrices[i].style.display = "none";
  }
  var active = document.getElementsByClassName("matrix-" + selected);
  for (var i = 0; i < active.length; i++) active[i].style.display = "block";
}
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() { toggleMetricMatrix(); });
</script>
')

# Generate matrices per file
for (f in fasta_files) {
  if (!file.exists(f)) next
  
  dna <- read.dna(f, format = "fasta")
  
  # 1. Hclust & MOTU grouping on uncorrected p-distance
  d_raw_dist <- dist.dna(dna, model = "raw", as.matrix = FALSE, pairwise.deletion = TRUE)
  
  # Handle NAs for hclust by setting them to the maximum distance safely
  if(any(is.na(d_raw_dist))) {
     max_d <- max(d_raw_dist, na.rm = TRUE)
     d_raw_dist[is.na(d_raw_dist)] <- if(is.infinite(max_d)) 1 else max_d
  }
  
  hc <- hclust(d_raw_dist, method = "average")
  motu_clusters <- cutree(hc, h = 0.05)
  date_str <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")
  
  models <- c("raw" = "raw", "K80" = "K80", "JC69" = "JC69", "TN93" = "TN93", "T92" = "T92")
  
  if(length(fasta_files) > 1) {
    cat(sprintf("\n### File: %s\n\n", basename(f)))
  }
  
  # Group by unique MOTUs
  unique_motus <- sort(unique(motu_clusters))
  
  for (motu_id in unique_motus) {
    motu_label <- sprintf("%s-%s", date_str, motu_id)
    seqs_in_motu <- names(motu_clusters)[motu_clusters == motu_id]
    
    # Declare MOTU with a markdown heading
    cat(sprintf("\n#### MOTU: %s\n\n", motu_label))
    
    for (m_name in names(models)) {
      m_code <- models[[m_name]]
      mat <- get_dist_matrix(dna, m_code)
      
      # Subset matrix specifically to this MOTU's sequences
      mat_sub <- mat[seqs_in_motu, seqs_in_motu, drop = FALSE]
      
      # Create Dataframe for Reactable, stripping rownames to avoid duplication
      df_mat <- as.data.frame(mat_sub)
      rownames(df_mat) <- NULL 
      df_mat <- cbind(Sequence = seqs_in_motu, df_mat)
      
      max_val <- max(mat_sub, na.rm = TRUE)
      if(is.infinite(max_val) || max_val == 0) max_val <- 1
      
      col_defs <- list(
        Sequence = colDef(sticky = "left", minWidth = 150, style = list(fontWeight = "bold", backgroundColor = "var(--tbl-bg)"))
      )
      
      for (cname in seqs_in_motu) {
        col_defs[[cname]] <- colDef(
          minWidth = 80,
          format = colFormat(digits = 4),
          style = function(value) {
            if(is.nan(value) || is.na(value)) return(list(color = "transparent"))
            list(backgroundColor = get_rgba(value, max_val))
          },
          cell = function(value) {
            if(is.nan(value) || is.na(value)) "" else formatC(value, format="f", digits=4)
          }
        )
      }
      
      cat(sprintf('<div class="dist-matrix matrix-%s matrix-wrapper" style="display: none;">\n', m_name))
      
      tbl <- reactable(
        df_mat,
        theme = dynamic_theme,
        rownames = FALSE,       
        pagination = FALSE,
        sortable = FALSE,       
        compact = TRUE,
        fullWidth = FALSE,      # <-- added to prevent table stretching across entire page
        columns = col_defs,
        style = list(fontSize = "13px") # <-- updated for slightly larger font
      )
      
      print(htmltools::tagList(tbl))
      cat('</div>\n')
    }
  }
}
```
